title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Tropical Guava Kiwi Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Guava Kiwi Ice from the Doozy Seriously Tropical Nic Salt collection combines the tangy taste of kiwi with the sweet notes of guava and a cool ice finish. This e-liquid offers a balanced fruit and menthol flavour that's perfect for vapers who enjoy a mix of tangy, sweet, and cool notes. Doozy Seriously Tropical Nic Salt e-liquids are crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, making them perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, these Nicotine Salt e-liquids offer a smooth, comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine delivery, ideal for adult smokers and vapers looking for effective nicotine relief that doesn’t compromise on flavour. Doozy Vape Co., based in the UK, are renowned for creating high-quality e-liquids in a staggering variety of exciting flavour profiles you won’t find anywhere else. Their Seriously Tropical Nic Salt collection brings together some of the most vibrant and tropical exotic fruit blends for a sweet, satisfying and sunny vaping experience.
